author: adachi0130
title: Adachi-Inpaint-Workbench
description: Paint the inpaint mask directly on the node canvas instead of a modal mask editor, with no save/load round-trip per stroke. The connected inpaint node hosts the live painting tools and WebUI-style sampling controls, and supports whole-image or padded masked-area sampling with original-resolution compositing, Alt temporary erase, Ctrl+wheel brush size, hover image comparison and one-click adoption of a result as the next source image. MIT licensed; reuses ComfyUI's NumPy, Pillow and PyTorch.
